description: Deletes a subscription item without canceling the subscription. Use when you need to remove a specific item from a customer's subscription while keeping the subscription active.

inputSchema.description: Request model for deleting a subscription item.

clear_usage.description: Delete all usage records for the subscription item. Only applicable when the plan's usage_type is metered.
clear_usage.title: Clear Usage

item.description: The identifier of the subscription item to be deleted.
item.title: Item

proration_behavior.description: Handles proration adjustments during billing changes. Default: create_prorations. Options: always_invoice (invoice immediately), create_prorations (add proration items to next invoice), none (disable proration).
proration_behavior.title: Proration Behavior

proration_date.description: Sets the calculation date for proration as a Unix timestamp. Useful for matching previewed amounts from the upcoming invoice endpoint.
proration_date.title: Proration Date

inputSchema.title: DeleteSubscriptionItemRequest

name: delete_subscription_item

DeleteSubscriptionItemResponse.description: Response model for a deleted subscription item.

deleted.description: Confirmation flag set to true upon successful deletion.
deleted.title: Deleted

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'subscription_item' for this endpoint.
object.title: Object

DeleteSubscriptionItemResponse.title: DeleteSubscriptionItemResponse
